Issues:
1. [major LOGIC] at T10: T10 (Test mobile responsiveness) depends on T4 (Implement reminder email feature), but testing mobile responsiveness does not require the reminder email feature to be implemented. (fix: Change T10's dependency to 'after: T1' or 'after: T2' (or the relevant UI implementation step) instead of T4.)
2. [major LOGIC] at T11: T11 (Test personal data privacy) depends on T4 (Implement reminder email feature), but testing data privacy does not require the reminder email feature to be implemented. (fix: Change T11's dependency to 'after: T2' or 'after: T3' (where user data is handled) instead of T4.)
3. [major LOGIC] at T9: T9 (Test page load performance) depends on T4 (Implement reminder email feature), but testing page load performance does not require the reminder email feature to be implemented. (fix: Change T9's dependency to 'after: T1' or 'after: T2' (or the main UI implementation steps) instead of T4.)
4. [major LOGIC] at R8: There is no implementation step for R8 (mobile responsiveness) or R7 (performance), only test steps that depend on unrelated features. (fix: Add an implementation step for mobile responsiveness (e.g., responsive CSS) and ensure performance optimizations are part of the build steps.)

Notes from earlier attempts:
- The test steps T10, T11, and T9 incorrectly depend on the unrelated implementation step T4, and there are missing implementation steps for R8 and R7, leaving the plan incomplete and logically inconsistent. Remove the dependencies of T10, T11, and T9 on T4, add implementation steps for R8 (mobile responsiveness) and R7 (performance), and ensure each test step depends only on its required implementation.

Requirements:
R1 [must] Students must be able to browse upcoming events by date and category.
R2 [must] Students must be able to book a seat and cancel a booking.
R3 [must] The website must stop bookings when an event is full.
R4 [must] Organisers must be able to create and edit their own events.
R5 [should] Organisers should be able to download the list of attendees as a CSV file.
R6 [could] The website could send reminder emails one day before an event.
R7 [must] Pages must load in under two seconds on the campus network.
R8 [must] The website must work on mobile phones.
R9 [must] Personal data must only be visible to the event organiser.

Plan steps:

verify [research] Check the research findings (requirements: -; after: research) criteria: every claim the design uses is supported by a source; unsupported claims are marked
design [design] Design the solution (requirements: -; after: verify) criteria: each part has a module and an interface; the skeleton runs; the design follows the constraints; C1 respected: The backend must be written in Python with Django or FastAPI.
T1 [implement] Implement event browsing (requirements: R1; after: design) criteria: Students must be able to browse upcoming events by date and category.
T2 [implement] Implement booking and cancellation (requirements: R2, R3; after: T1) criteria: Students must be able to book a seat and cancel a booking.; The website must stop bookings when an event is full.
T3 [implement] Implement organiser event management (requirements: R4, R5; after: T1) criteria: Organisers must be able to create and edit their own events.; Organisers should be able to download the list of attendees as a CSV file.
T5 [test] Test event browsing (requirements: R1; after: T1) criteria: Students must be able to browse upcoming events by date and category.
T6 [test] Test booking and full capacity handling (requirements: R2, R3; after: T2) criteria: Students must be able to book a seat and cancel a booking.; The website must stop bookings when an event is full.
T7 [test] Test organiser management and CSV export (requirements: R4, R5; after: T3) criteria: Organisers must be able to create and edit their own events.; Organisers should be able to download the list of attendees as a CSV file.
T4 [implement] Implement reminder email feature (requirements: R6; after: T2, T3) criteria: The website could send reminder emails one day before an event.
T10 [test] Test mobile responsiveness (requirements: R8; after: T4) criteria: The website must work on mobile phones.
T11 [test] Test personal data privacy (requirements: R9; after: T4) criteria: Personal data must only be visible to the event organiser.
T9 [test] Test page load performance (requirements: R7; after: T4) criteria: Pages must load in under two seconds on the campus network.
T8 [test] Test reminder email sending (requirements: R6; after: T4) criteria: The website could send reminder emails one day before an event.
T12 [document] Prepare Requirements specification (requirements: -; after: T5, T6, T7, T8, T9, T10, T11) criteria: D1 exists: Requirements specification as PDF; it matches the finished, tested work
T13 [document] Prepare Test report (requirements: -; after: T5, T6, T7, T8, T9, T10, T11) criteria: D3 exists: Test report as PDF; it matches the finished, tested work
review [review] Final review (requirements: -; after: T12, T13) criteria: every must requirement is met; every deliverable is present; C1 respected: The backend must be written in Python with Django or FastAPI.; C2 respected: The project budget for hosting is zero; use the university server.
